commit.description: Commit OID (full hex) checked out when the command ran.

new.description: Commit OID at `HEAD` after rewrite (full hex).

old.description: Commit OID at `HEAD` before rewrite (full hex).

RefPair.description: One ref tip before and after rewrite.

name.description: Deprecated duplicate of [`Self::ref_name`]; removed in a future release.

RewrittenPair.description: One commit OID before and after rewrite.

change_id.description: Stored `change-id` on the replacement commit, or JSON `null` when dropped or absent.

new.description: Replacement commit OID (full hex), or JSON `null` when the commit was dropped.

subject.description: First line of the replacement commit message, or the original when dropped.

description: Result of `grit history drop`, `move`, `reword`, `fixup`, `squash`, `absorb`, `rebase`, and `undo`, and top-level `grit rebase`.

dry_run.description: Whether refs were left unchanged (`true` for `--dry-run`).

exec.description: `--exec` subprocess results when `--exec` was used (success only).

head.description: Previous and new `HEAD` commit OIDs when `HEAD`'s commit changes; JSON `null` when unchanged.

refs.description: Planned or applied ref tip updates.

rewritten.description: Original and replacement commit OIDs for every rewritten commit.

title: HistoryRewriteOutcome
